title: 9 Stocks to Buy in Our DREAM 2026 Portfolio
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
summary: A '2026 stock draft' hosted by Joseph Hogue with co-host Bridget Bennett (MarketBeat): Mark Roussin, Tom Nash and Kieran Francis snake-draft three stocks each for the best 2026 returns. Mark's board: (1) AMZN - diversified quality compounder, $200B AI capex 'all-in,' EV/EBITDA near historic lows, 'I wish I invested more'; (2) GOOGL - his largest position, +65% over 12 months, built Gemini in-house instead of acquiring, search/YouTube/ads/cloud/Waymo make it a 'must-own'; (3) NVDA - forward PE ~24 against ~50% expected earnings growth for two years (PEG ~0.5), Jensen Huang, hyperscaler AI capex flowing to Nvidia. Mark also confirms he recently bought and added to MRVL (Kieran's high-speed-interconnect pick) and names Boeing, SoFi and Robinhood as liked-but-undrafted watchlist names. The rest of the draft: Tom Nash takes PLTR (60%/yr growth, $7B cash, no debt), TSLA (robotics/energy/FSD over autos) and VOO as the anchor; Kieran Francis takes MRVL (next AI bottleneck, PE 27 vs AVGO 60), MSFT (Azure growing 41%/38%, 'best price in a decade') and ZS; Hogue adds his own SMCI ('loading up') and ETHA; Bennett notes MarketBeat analysts' AMD bullishness and drone names like Redcat. Calls: AMZN, GOOGL, NVDA, MRVL BUY (Mark); BA, SOFI, HOOD UNCERTAIN. Note: 'Rousen' = Roussin; 'Palunteer' = Palantir; Redcat/Dragonfly mentioned with no explicit buy call.
